classification_read.finding: Three severity leaves plus three drug-induced leaves; EB13 coded-elsewhere EH63 distinguishes established drug cause. WHO EB13.0 says no more than9%; current clinical <10% convention is explicitly clinical, not a claim of identical literal ICD wording.

findings.resolution: Added disputed systemic steroid benefit and infection concern, supported by DermNet treatment and independently authored MSD. No efficacy guarantee or self-treatment regimen.
Removed single-source exercise prescription; persistent emotional symptoms reporting retained with BAD and DermNet psychiatric-support basis.
Action kind and content narrowed to culprit/nonessential withdrawal and clear avoidance records, supported by Mayo/BAD.
Added actually read DermNet RIME page; distinguishes evolving pediatric infection terminology from drug-induced SJS/TEN.

dispute_adjudication.resolution: Common <10/10-30/>30 clinical classification retained; DermNet TEN-without-spots variant and WHO literal9% definition not conflated. Immunomodulator evidence/selection vary; uncertainty and infection risk explicit, supportive care central.

resolution: Four first-pass findings resolved by one targeted revision. Fourteen dimensions provide lay recognition, cause, assessment, immediate care, treatment purpose/risk, practical intake/recovery and avoidance; bilingual conditions/numeric thresholds match. Editorial content acceptance only.
